observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission with a 12V battery cable attached.
The transmission is surrounded by other car parts in a workshop or scrap yard environment.
The input shaft and output shaft flanges are visible.
The input shaft flange has a stamped 'X15' marking.
The output shaft flange has a stamped 'X15' marking.
The transmission casing shows significant surface dirt and grime.
No brand name, model number, or engine capacity label is legible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show a used transmission but do not show a label or sticker confirming the brand.
No Ford Fusion badge or model-specific part number is visible in the photos.
The photos show the transmission but do not show the engine or any engine capacity label.

risks.risk: The transmission may be seized or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the transmission being operated through all gears.

risks.risk: The transmission may be a different model or fitment than the Ford Fusion.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number sticker on the transmission casing.

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing the input shaft or output shaft flanges.
risks.proof: A photo of the input shaft flange and output shaft flange.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the part number sticker on the transmission casing.
Video of the transmission being operated through all gears.
Photo of the input shaft flange and output shaft flange.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
